name: graph-first-test-pending
body: The `requirements.requirement.graph-first-navigation` AC5 acceptance criterion is met by the real test `rust.main_e2e.e2e.graph_first_rule_stated_in_navigator_prompt_and_guide` (`tests/main_e2e.rs`), which asserts that the navigator prompt states the graph-first ordering (`Graph first, then file read`), that the rule names both artifact classes, that `AGENTS.md` carries the confirm-and-anchor qualifier, and that `agent-builder.md` rule 5 propagates the ordering to generated agents. The governing component `solution.component.navigator-prompt-guidance` is `implemented-by` `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md` and `opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md`. The AC5 test asserts the presence of the two class labels. The read-guard test beside it is `rust.main_e2e.e2e.installed_agent_prompts_state_file_access_read_guard`.
